subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following alternatives will replace the question mark?

**Atom, Molecule, Cell, ?**
solution:
The sequence is arranged in increasing order of structural complexity.

 

 
• Atom → basic unit of matter
 
• Molecule → combination of atoms
 
• Cell → basic unit of life (made of molecules)
 
• The next higher level of organization after a cell is a Tissue.
 
• Atom, Molecule, Cell, Tissue

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
